maria (sec): FYI found a plaintext Azure SAS token inside a third-party CI build artifact we ingest from partner X. artifact: partner-builds/2026-03-22/build-123.tar.gz :eyes:
kevin (eng): omg ok can you paste the exact match or grep you used?
maria (sec): grep: `strings build-123.tar.gz | grep -E 'sv=|se=|sig='` -> matched `https://ourpartner.blob.core.windows.net/container/blob?sv=2023-02-01&se=2027-01-01&sig=...`
jane (platform): tagging oncall. we should block the webhook from ingesting new artifacts until rotation is done. can we flip the partner webhook to 403 for now?
tim (devex): agree. also need to know who uses that SAS — CI runners, partner ingestion Lambda?
maria (sec): looks like ingestion lambda & a small set of nightly jobs in partner CI. I cross-checked access logs: read-only access only but still unacceptable.
kevin (eng): I'll revoke the storage account key and generate a new one. plan: 1) revoke, 2) reissue new key, 3) create short-lived SAS tokens for consumers via Vault and KMS-wrapped envelope keys.
jane (platform): +1. make sure we rotate both primary and secondary keys to avoid re-use. also enable blob audit logging (storage analytics) with 90d retention and export to secure logging bucket. file a runbook entry.
maria (sec): important: update RBAC for the new SAS issuance service principal — restrict to only `Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/listKeys/action` for the rotate job and `Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blob/read` for consumers. Also enable diagnostic settings -> send to our Log Analytics workspace.
kevin (eng): prepping a PR to change the partner ingestion config to read secret from Vault path `secret/data/partnerX/azure-sas`. I'll add a migration script to fetch the new SAS and rotate envs. ETA 45m.
tim (devex): I'll make the Vault policy: `path "secret/data/partnerX/*" { capabilities = ["read"] }` for the ingestion identity and enable Azure KeyVault-to-Vault sync as a fallback. also annotate the secret with `created_by=sec_incident_4443219876`.
sre-bot: Incident ticket created: SEC-2026-0457. On-call notified.
maria (sec): action items: kevin revoke keys now (do not delete artifacts), kevin issue new keys and create short-lived SAS via our rotate job, tim add Vault policy & store new SAS, jane flip webhook to 403 until we confirm pulls from Vault, kevin update CI PR.
kevin (eng): revoking primary key now. running: `az storage account keys renew --account-name ourpartner --key primary` (insecure to paste here).
maria (sec): once new key is up, generate SAS with expiry 2h, test ingestion, then swap to Vault flow. keep audit trail.
kevin (eng): new key active. created SAS and pushed to Vault at `secret/data/partnerX/azure-sas` with metadata. Posted PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/ingest/+/2345 (updates env and adds Vault read).
jane (platform): webhook returned 403 to partner earlier. partner confirmed they can retry. I've enabled Storage analytics and diagnostic export -> logs-storage-secure.
tim (devex): applied Vault policy, set TTL for the secret to 2h and created a rotation job cron -> runs every 1h to regenerate SAS via KMS-wrapped signing flow.
maria (sec): please attach audit logs to the incident. we need list of principals that accessed `secret/data/partnerX/azure-sas` and storage account listKey calls.
sre-bot: Audit export scheduled: logs from Log Analytics -> incident S3 export job queued.
kevin (eng): verified ingestion works from Vault-backed SAS. Smoke passed in staging.
maria (sec): final checks: ensure old SAS (from artifact) is invalidated (it was tied to old key). confirm in logs that no writes occurred.
jane (platform): confirmed: no write operations found; only reads. old SAS no longer valid after key rotation.
maria (sec): good — close on rotation. follow-up: create a short security policy for incoming partner artifacts: block plaintext secrets, require artifact scanning pre-ingest, and require partner use Vault/KMS or encrypted blob access. I'll create a short RFC.
kevin (eng): noted, I'll also add a CI check that fails the build if it contains patterns like `sv=|se=|sig=`.
maria (sec): thanks everyone. closing SEC ticket after attaching migration artifacts and logs. :thumbsup:
